products.title: WP Fingerboard Hanging Pouch — Handmade Faux Leather with Clip
products.body_html:
A handmade faux-leather fingerboard pouch with a clip closure and hanging hook from WP is the kind of carry piece that treats your fingerboard as the equipment it is rather than an afterthought in a bag. The clip and hanging hook mean it can attach to a bag strap, backpack loop or hook on the wall — keeping the board accessible and protected wherever you are.

Why this one

  • Handmade faux leather construction — a material and finish that holds its shape and resists scuffing better than fabric pouches
  • Clip and hanging hook closure — the board stays secured during movement and the whole pouch can clip to a bag exterior or hang from a hook when stored
  • WP (Whitepolar) original design — a fingerboard-brand accessory made for their own community rather than a repurposed general pouch
  • Portable format keeps the fingerboard and its components together during transit — no loose wheels or screws rolling around in a bag
  • Works as both daily carry and wall-hung display when not in active use

Specifications

BrandWP (Whitepolar)
MaterialFaux leather (handmade)
FasteningClip with hanging hook
Pack size1

Who it suits

Riders who want their fingerboard carried properly rather than loose in a backpack — and those who want a WP brand accessory to match a WP setup. The clip design makes this suitable for clipping to a bag exterior so the fingerboard is reachable without opening the main compartment.

Hand-picked and quality-checked before dispatch. Free sticker sheet in every box, and 30-day returns if it is not right for you.

products.title: Fingerboard Storage Bag
products.body_html:
A fingerboard carried loose in a bag comes back with scratched graphics, missing hardware, and a scuffed deck — a dedicated storage bag solves all three problems at once, and this one does it in a compact form that fits anywhere.

Why this one

  • Protects a complete setup — trucks and wheels attached — during travel, so the board you packed is the board you ride at the other end.
  • Compact form factor fits in a backpack or jacket pocket without displacing other contents.
  • Keeps components organised so bearings, spare bushings, and hardware do not scatter loose inside a larger bag.
  • Straightforward construction that works equally well for daily carry and for packing a setup between sessions.
  • Fits standard fingerboard with trucks and wheels attached — no disassembly required for packing.

Specifications

TypeStorage and carry bag
FitsStandard fingerboard with trucks and wheels attached

Who it suits

Riders who carry their fingerboard regularly and want a dedicated, protective carry solution rather than loose storage in a larger bag. A practical first accessory for anyone who travels between sessions or takes a board to events.

Hand-picked and quality-checked before dispatch. Free sticker sheet in every box, and 30-day returns if it is not right for you.

products.title: 4-in-1 Fingerboard Display Stand — Holds 4 Decks with Storage
products.body_html:
A display stand built to hold four fingerboards at once turns a collection into something you can actually see and reach rather than something stacked in a box. The 4-in-1 format means four setups are displayed simultaneously — an honest answer to how most serious riders accumulate boards.

Why this one

  • Holds 4 fingerboards — displays a collection rather than a single board, so multiple setups are visible and accessible at once
  • Integrated storage for each board position — keeps decks, trucks and wheels together rather than separating components across a shelf
  • 4-in-1 display format shows off colourways, graphics and deck shapes side by side — the visual appeal of a collection is part of the point
  • Compact footprint for desk or shelf display — does not require a dedicated cabinet or case
  • Structured stand construction protects decks from the casual damage of being stacked flat

Specifications

Capacity4 fingerboards
FormatDisplay stand with storage
Pack size1 stand

Who it suits

Collectors or active riders with multiple setups who want them displayed rather than stored out of sight. Four positions suits a rider with separate deck shapes, colourways or wheel setups who wants a clean, organised surface display rather than a pile.

Hand-picked and quality-checked before dispatch. Free sticker sheet in every box, and 30-day returns if it is not right for you.

products.title: Fingerboard Storage Case — Aluminium & Acrylic (Holds 6)
products.body_html:
An aluminium and acrylic case that holds six complete fingerboards is both a serious storage solution and a display piece — the transparent acrylic face means a curated collection stays visible even when it is packed away.

Why this one

  • Holds up to 6 fingerboards, making it the practical storage choice for riders who maintain multiple setups or collect complete boards.
  • Acrylic panel keeps the collection visible inside the case — no unpacking required to find a specific setup or to show the collection.
  • Aluminium construction provides genuine impact protection during transport, not just dust coverage.
  • Available in black, silver, and grey — three finishes that each read differently as a display object on a shelf or desk.
  • Doubles as a display case and a transport case, so it earns its space whether the collection is in storage or on show.

Specifications

Capacity6 fingerboards
MaterialAluminium body, acrylic panel
ColourwaysBlack, silver, grey

Who it suits

Collectors and riders who maintain several setups and want a single, considered solution that protects boards in transit and displays them clearly at home. The aluminium body suits anyone who travels to events with a quiver; the acrylic face suits anyone who treats their collection as something worth looking at.

Hand-picked and quality-checked before dispatch. Free sticker sheet in every box, and 30-day returns if it is not right for you.
